# csv-spectrum

Source: <https://github.com/max-mapper/csv-spectrum>, commit
`d30e80f8b99d2eecb3778f1d7b9ed1cb425502ec` (2024-07-04), by Max Ogden,
licensed BSD-2-Clause as `package.json` declares (`"license":
"BSD-2-Clause"`, `"author": "max ogden"`). The repository carries no licence
file, so `LICENSE` holds the BSD 2-Clause text, as SPDX publishes it, with
the copyright line taken from the `author` of `package.json`; no year is
given because no upstream file states one. `package.json` and `readme.md`
are kept unchanged as the record of authorship and licence.

Vendored: `csvs/` and `json/`, unchanged.
